title: Determining newforms via arithmetic relations among Fourier coefficients
summary: We investigate the distribution of primes satisfying arithmetic inequalities involving the Fourier coefficients of two non-CM newforms at prime powers. More precisely, we establish asymptotic formulas for the number of primes for which the differences, products, and ratios of the Fourier coefficients satisfy prescribed inequalities, together with explicit estimates for the corresponding densities.
